name: Agent — sec-researcher (Flux revision / weekly sweep / form) → plans repo issues

parameters.formDescription: Starts a read-only sec-researcher run (access control). Findings are filed as issues in the private plans repo; a summary is pushed to ntfy topic agent-runs.

values.formSubmittedText: Started. The summary will arrive as an ntfy push (topic agent-runs).

parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runs (run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, agent TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT, event_type TEXT, subject TEXT, started TIMESTAMPTZ, finished TIMESTAMPTZ, exit_reason TEXT, outcome TEXT, summary TEXT, outputs JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_runs_created_idx ON agent_runs (created_at DESC); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_dedupe (dedupe_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, agent TEXT NOT NULL, subject TEXT, last_event_id TEXT, first_launched TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), last_launched TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), cooldown_until TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, launches INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_plan_filings (run_id TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, rule TEXT, resource TEXT, severity TEXT, action TEXT NOT NULL, issue_number INT, issue_url TEXT, http_status INT, detail TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY (run_id, fingerprint)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_plan_filings_fp_idx ON agent_plan_filings (fingerprint, created_at DESC);

WITH s AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p), claim AS ( INSERT INTO agent_dedupe AS d (dedupe_key, agent, subject, last_event_id, last_launched, cooldown_until) SELECT p->>'dedupe_key', 'sec-researcher', p->>'subject', NULL, now(), now() + make_interval(hours => GREATEST(COALESCE((p->>'cooldown_hours')::int, 1), 1)) FROM s WHERE COALESCE(p->>'dedupe_key', '') <> '' ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO UPDATE SET last_launched = now(), cooldown_until = EXCLUDED.cooldown_until, subject = EXCLUDED.subject, launches = d.launches + 1 WHERE d.cooldown_until <= now() RETURNING d.dedupe_key), base AS (SELECT d.subject FROM agent_dedupe d, s WHERE d.dedupe_key LIKE 'sec-researcher:flux-rev:%' AND d.dedupe_key <> s.p->>'dedupe_key' ORDER BY d.first_launched DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim) AS claimed, (SELECT subject FROM base) AS base;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ agent: $('Build Event').first().json.agent, event: $('Build Event').first().json.event, callback: $json.callback }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO agent_runs (run_id, agent, event_id, event_type, subject, started, finished, exit_reason, outcome, summary, outputs) SELECT p->>'run_id', p->>'agent', p->>'event_id', p->>'event_type', p->>'subject', (p->>'started')::timestamptz, (p->>'finished')::timestamptz, p->>'exit_reason', p->>'outcome', p->>'summary', COALESCE(p->'outputs', '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) AS s ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING run_id, agent, outcome, exit_reason, summary, outputs;

INSERT INTO agent_plan_filings (run_id, fingerprint, rule, resource, severity, action, issue_number, issue_url, http_status, detail) SELECT f->>'run_id', f->>'fingerprint', f->>'rule', f->>'resource', f->>'severity', f->>'action', (f->>'issue_number')::int, f->>'issue_url', (f->>'http_status')::int, f->>'detail' FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb->'filings') AS f ON CONFLICT (run_id, fingerprint) DO NOTHING;
